classification.conformanceProfile: bounded flat primitive tabular Parquet profile

formatPolicy.schemaEvolution: outside R1; one exact dataset contract is bound per verification
formatPolicy.rowOrderSemantics: row order is not authoritative in R1; canonical comparison is by the declared primary key

contractSchema.claim: dataset contract is valid under the shadow dataset-contract-v1 JSON Schema

parquetSchema.claim: native Parquet physical/logical/repetition schema agrees with the concrete dataset contract

readerMatrix.claim: independent mature readers agree on row count, schema-relevant facts and canonical logical rows

keyIntegrity.claim: declared primary-key columns exist, are non-null and unique

rowBounds.claim: row count satisfies any contract minimum/maximum bounds

nonClaims: truth or provenance of field values
statistical quality, representativeness or absence of bias
unit/ontology correctness not encoded by the concrete contract
database constraints beyond the declared Artifact dataset contract
